Support Group

Saturday May 3rd, 2014

10:00 – 11:00 AM

                  Topic:    Body Contouring after Weight Loss

                  When:    Saturday May 3rd, 2014

                  Time:     10:00 – 11:00 AM

                 Where:   10475 Reading Rd, Evendale, OH 45241

Come and meet Dr. Jennifer Butterfield MD, voted one of the best plastic surgeons in Cincinnati!

Her work has been described as a “surgical art of possibilities”.  Dr. Butterfield also recognizes that body contouring after weight loss can be intimidating.  Her calm and friendly personality helps to make the process very comfortable. Look forward to seeing you all there!

RSVP:  rebecca@thebanddoctor.com
